model_overflow.name: The Model Calls Itself
model_overflow.description: Step through bounded calls without a base case, a forgotten transform restore, and wrapped vertex writes. The earlier arcade supplies the first two models; a retained indexed skin shows wrong data at valid addresses. Explicit simulations, no native memory fault.
interactions: Select SOURCE, CALLS, LEAK or WRAP.
Turn STEPS and CAPACITY; press STEP or PLAY / HOLD. CAPACITY applies to CALLS and LEAK.
model_overflow.qfep_connection: A bounded generator makes visible what must be retained, restored or refused. The location and meaning of a limit differ between stack frames and model data; computational fault and aesthetic interpretation remain distinct.
model_overflow.status: preview only; not placed on the museum route
